title: T10 — Architecture artefact index (rework, 2026-11-22)
body:
# Architecture Artefacts — T10 SAFe cadence and MSP tranches

## Metadata

Seven approved retrospective A–D artefacts of the adopted profile (all approved by the
Architecture Board; authored in the rework record).

## Entries

| Phase | Kind | Artefact | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| A | matrix | Stakeholder Map | approved |
| A | catalog | Driver/Goal/Objective Catalog | approved |
| A | catalog | Requirements Catalog | approved |
| A | diagram | Solution Concept Diagram | approved |
| B | diagram | Business Capability Map | approved |
| C | catalog | Data Entity/Data Component Catalog | approved |
| D | catalog | Technology Standards Catalog | approved |

## Links

Each artefact is a typed `architecture_artifact` row (kind bound to the standard's
`artifact_type`) and is read back through `architecture.artifacts_get`; the requirements
catalog traces the five §12 clauses; the solution concept derives from the charter's scope.

## Document

The published documents: `T10 — project brief` and `T10 — evidence`, and this index as the
architecture-artifact document. The Phase-G review `architecture.reviews_record` ties the set
to the live contract.
